Substantial percentage of these women claim to have forceful and path defining narratives
in the political scheme of thing. Thereby they claim to have played an influencing role
towards political discourse at large. A small percentage of these women however were
not able to engage in a forceful political dialogue, primarily because of their hesitancy to
bring forth their political views on table. They thus claim to have played little or no role
in shaping of political agendas. (Table 6.25).

Majority amongst these women (54.4%) are of the opinion that there is a gender equality
within these grass root political bodies. Some of these women do go the extent of
proclaiming a positive female gender bias which has led them to work in an environment
which is not overwhelmed by the presence of males. 18.4% of women however are of the
view that male preponderance has been a defining factor which has handicapped their
ability to function.
